senses.gloss:
n. (-नं)
Reckoning, computing.
2 Considering, deliberating.
3 Discharge of a debt.
E.
वि before गणन counting.

ind.
1 Having deliberated or weighed.
2 Having reckoned.
E.
वि before गण to number, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Reckoned, calculated.
2 Weighed, considered.
3 Discharged, (as a debt.)
E.
वि before गण to count, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Gone, departed, disappeared.
2 Separated, severed, parted.
3 Freed or exempt from.
4 Lost.
5 Gloomy, dark, obscured.
E.
वि implying disunion, (of light, &c.,) गत gone.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
1 Pure, righteous.
2 Unsoiled.
E.
विगत, and कल्मष sin.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Exempted from decay.
2 Cured of fever.
E.
विगत, and ज्वरा decay, or ज्वर fever.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Devoid of passion or affection.
E.
विगत, and राग passion.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Unfortunate, unprosperous.
E.
विगत gone, श्री prosperity, कप् aff.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Indifferent, devoid of wish or desire.
E.
विगत, and स्पृहा desire.

f. (-वा)
A woman past child-bearing.
E.
विगत gone, आर्त्तव the menstrual excretion.

m. (-मः)
Separation, parting.
E.
वि apart, and गम going.

m. (-रः)
1 An abstemious man, one who feeds on wind.
2 A naked man.
3 A mountain.

nf. (-णं-णा)
Abuse, abusing, censure, reproach.
E.
वि before गर्ह to abuse, युच् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Bad, wicked, reprehensible.
E.
वि before गर्ह to abuse, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Abused, reviled.
2 Low, vile.
3 Bad, wicked.
E.
वि before गर्ह to abuse, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-र्ह्यः-र्ह्या-र्ह्यं)
Blamable, reprehensible.
ind.
Having blamed or reviled.
E.
वि before गर्ह to abuse, यत् or ल्यप् aff.

f. (-था)
Scandal, abuse.
E.
विगर्ह्य, and कथा speech.

mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्)
1 Oozing, dropping, flowing.
2 Fading, dispersing, weakening, (as emotion, &c.)
E.
वि before गल to ooze, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Fallen, dropped, oozed, flowing.
2 Removed, gone.
3 Dissipated, dispersed.
4 Decayed, impaired.
5 Slackened, untied, (as a knot.)
6 Loose, disordered, (as dress.)
E.
वि before गल to ooze, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
Having the hair dishevelled.
E.
विगलित, and केश hair.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Immersed, plunged, bathed, bathing.
2 Much, exceeding.
3 Flowing copiously.
E.
वि before गाह to bathe, aff. क्त.

n. (-नं)
1 Ill report, detraction, scandal.
2 Censure, reproach.
E.
वि depreciative prefix, गै to sing or sound, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-हः)
1 Bathing.
2 Plunging into, literally or figuratively, (as water, a crowd, &c.)
E.
वि before गाह to bathe, अच् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Beholding, perceiving.
2 Knowing.
3 Bathing.
4 Going, proceeding.
E.
वि before गाह to agitate, aff. शानच्.

ind.
Having bathed or plunged in.
E.
वि before गाह to agitate, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Contradicted, contradictory, inconsistent.
2 Abused, reproached.
3 Sung or said in various ways.
4 Sung ill.
E.
वि, and गीत sung.

f. (-तिः)
1 Reproach, abuse.
2 Contradiction.
3 Singing in various styles.
4 Singing ill.
E.
वि, and गीति singing.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Void of all qualities.
2 Bad, worthless, having no merit.
E.
वि, and गुण quality.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Concealed, hidden.
2 Blamed, reproached, censured.
E.
वि before गुह to conceal, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Opposed, obstructed, prevented.
2 Encountered, as in fight.
E.
वि before ग्रह to seize, क्त aff.

ind.
Having warred or contended with.
E.
वि before ग्रह to take, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Being warred upon or contended with.
E.
वि before ग्रह to take, pass. v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं)
Noseless.
E.
वि privative prefix, and ग्र substituted for नासिका.

m. (-हः)
1 The body.
2 Extension, diffusion.
3 A portion, a part.
4 Shape, form, figure.
5 (A grammatical term,) the proper application or sense of a compound word.
mn. (-हः-हं)
1 War, battle.
2 Opposition, encounter.
E.
वि various, (happiness, &c.) ग्रह to take, aff. अच्.

n. (-रं)
The back.
E.
विग्रह the body, and अवर the back.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
To be warred or contended with.
E.
वि before ग्रह to take, ण्यत् aff.
